subject: Make soft loop nudge loop-aware to stop zombie-loop pileup
description:
BUG: the non-auto soft-nudge path in lib/ready-flag-cache.js `readyInjection()` unconditionally emits "No active loop detected — call loop_control start immediately" on EVERY fire, with zero awareness of whether a loop is already active for the session. Result: each classify/heartbeat tick on a non-auto-accept session mints a fresh loop_control loop, accumulating zombie loops (observed 12+ in registry, all spawning the same ready tasks). AUTO mode (lib/loop-autostart.js maybeAutostartLoop) already guards correctly via hasActiveSessionLoop(loops, sessionId); the soft path has no equivalent.

FIX: thread loop-active state into the soft nudge, mirroring maybeAutostartLoop.
1. routes/classify.js: compute `const loopActive = hasActiveSessionLoop(ctx.loops, sessionId)` (import hasActiveSessionLoop from lib/loop-autostart) and pass `hasActiveLoop: loopActive` into assembleClassifyResponse.
2. lib/classify-assemble.js: accept `hasActiveLoop` in opts and pass it as a 3rd arg to readyInjection(sessionId, prompt, hasActiveLoop).
3. lib/ready-flag-cache.js: readyInjection(sessionId, prompt, hasActiveLoop) — when hasActiveLoop is true, emit the "loop already active → ScheduleWakeup(delaySeconds=270, watching active loop)" branch INSTEAD of the "No active loop detected → call loop_control start" branch. Keep the ready-task list + higher-priority-fallback lines in both branches. Default hasActiveLoop=false (backward compatible — callers that don't pass it keep current behavior).
4. test/loop-autostart.test.js: add coverage — (c2) non-auto + hasActiveLoop=true → nudge emits the "watching active loop" branch, NOT "No active loop detected". Keep existing (c-composer) test passing for hasActiveLoop=false. Update assemble() helper to thread hasActiveLoop.

VERIFY: `node --test test/loop-autostart.test.js` passes (existing + new cases). Also run the broader classify test if present.

CONTEXT: discovered during a live session where 12 zombie loops were stopped by hand. Root cause is the always-on "No active loop detected" string at lib/ready-flag-cache.js:53.

summary: Made the soft loop nudge loop-aware. readyInjection(sessionId, prompt, hasActiveLoop=false) now branches the middle line: hasActiveLoop=true emits "Loop already active — do NOT call loop_control start ... ScheduleWakeup(270, watching active loop)" instead of the "No active loop detected — call loop_control start" minting line. classify-assemble.js threads hasActiveLoop from opts into readyInjection (AUTO autostartLine path untouched). routes/classify.js imports hasActiveSessionLoop and computes loopActive = hasActiveSessionLoop(ctx.loops, sessionId), passing it as hasActiveLoop. Added test (non-auto + hasActiveLoop=true → "Loop already active" present, "No active loop detected" absent); existing (c-composer) start-nudge test retained. Files: lib/ready-flag-cache.js, lib/classify-assemble.js, routes/classify.js, test/loop-autostart.test.js. Tests: node --test test/loop-autostart.test.js → 11 pass, 0 fail. Commit 0bc0bd1.
